from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pybamm


class TestBaseSolverSolveCallCoverageQA:
    def _model(self, seed, with_event=False, with_input=False, second_state=False):
        model = pybamm.BaseModel(f"qa solve model {seed}")
        v = pybamm.Variable(f"qa solve v {seed}")
        rate = pybamm.InputParameter(f"qa rate {seed}") if with_input else pybamm.Scalar(0.15 + seed / 100)
        model.rhs = {v: -rate * v + pybamm.sin(v) / (seed + 20)}
        model.initial_conditions = {v: pybamm.Scalar(1)}
        model.variables = {v.name: v, f"qa energy {seed}": v**2}
        if second_state:
            u = pybamm.Variable(f"qa solve u {seed}")
            model.rhs[u] = v - pybamm.Scalar(0.2) * u
            model.initial_conditions[u] = pybamm.Scalar(seed / 20)
            model.variables[u.name] = u
        if with_event:
            model.events = [pybamm.Event(f"qa cutoff {seed}", v - pybamm.Scalar(0.55))]
        pybamm.Discretisation().process_model(model)
        return model

    def _solve(self, seed, solver, t_eval, event=False, input_value=None, second=False):
        model = self._model(seed, event, input_value is not None, second)
        inputs = {f"qa rate {seed}": input_value} if input_value is not None else None
        solution = solver.solve(model, t_eval=t_eval, inputs=inputs)
        assert len(solution.t) >= 2
        return solution

    def test_case_01(self): assert self._solve(1, pybamm.ScipySolver(method="RK45"), [0, 1]).termination == "final time"
    def test_case_02(self): assert self._solve(2, pybamm.ScipySolver(method="BDF"), np.linspace(0, 8, 30), True).termination.startswith("event")
    def test_case_03(self): assert self._solve(3, pybamm.ScipySolver(method="Radau"), np.linspace(0, 2, 15), False, None, True).termination == "final time"
    def test_case_04(self): assert self._solve(4, pybamm.ScipySolver(method="DOP853"), [0, 3], False, 0.3).termination == "final time"
    def test_case_05(self): assert self._solve(5, pybamm.CasadiSolver(mode="fast"), np.linspace(0, 1, 8)).termination == "final time"
    def test_case_06(self): assert self._solve(6, pybamm.CasadiSolver(mode="safe"), np.linspace(0, 2, 12), False, 0.25).termination == "final time"
    def test_case_07(self): assert self._solve(7, pybamm.ScipySolver(method="LSODA"), np.linspace(0, 4, 20), False, None, True).termination == "final time"
    def test_case_08(self): assert self._solve(8, pybamm.CasadiSolver(mode="fast with events"), np.linspace(0, 8, 25), True).termination.startswith("event")
    def test_case_09(self): assert self._solve(9, pybamm.ScipySolver(method="RK23"), np.linspace(0, 2, 11), False, 0.4, True).termination == "final time"
    def test_case_10(self): assert self._solve(10, pybamm.CasadiSolver(mode="safe"), [0, 2], False, None, True).termination == "final time"

138	        """Returns a copy of the solver"""
139	        new_solver = copy.copy(self)
140	        # clear _model_set_up
141	        new_solver._model_set_up = {}

144	    def set_up(self, model, inputs=None, t_eval=None, ics_only=False):
145	        """Unpack model, perform checks, and calculate jacobian.
146	
147	        Parameters
148	        ----------
149	        model : :class:`pybamm.BaseModel`
150	            The model whose solution to calculate. Must have attributes rhs and
151	            initial_conditions
152	        inputs : dict, optional
153	            Any input parameters to pass to the model when solving
154	        t_eval : numeric type, optional
155	            The times at which to stop the integration due to a discontinuity in time.
156	        """
157	        inputs = inputs or {}
158	
159	        if ics_only:
160	            pybamm.logger.info("Start solver set-up, initial_conditions only")
161	        else:
162	            pybamm.logger.info("Start solver set-up")
163	
164	        self._check_and_prepare_model_inplace(model, inputs, ics_only)
165	
166	        # set default calculate sensitivities on model
167	        if not hasattr(model, "calculate_sensitivities"):
168	            model.calculate_sensitivities = []
169	
170	        self._set_up_model_sensitivities_inplace(model, inputs)
171	
172	        vars_for_processing = self._get_vars_for_processing(model, inputs)
173	
174	        # Process initial conditions
175	        initial_conditions, _, jacp_ic, _ = process(
176	            model.concatenated_initial_conditions,
177	            "initial_conditions",
178	            vars_for_processing,
179	            use_jacobian=False,
180	        )
181	        model.initial_conditions_eval = initial_conditions
182	        model.jacp_initial_conditions_eval = jacp_ic
183	
184	        # set initial conditions
185	        self._set_initial_conditions(model, 0.0, inputs)
186	
187	        if ics_only:
188	            pybamm.logger.info("Finish solver set-up")
189	            return
190	
191	        # Process rhs, algebraic, residual and event expressions
192	        # and wrap in callables
193	        rhs, jac_rhs, jacp_rhs, jac_rhs_action = process(
194	            model.concatenated_rhs, "RHS", vars_for_processing
195	        )
196	
197	        algebraic, jac_algebraic, jacp_algebraic, jac_algebraic_action = process(
198	            model.concatenated_algebraic, "algebraic", vars_for_processing
199	        )
200	
201	        # combine rhs and algebraic functions
202	        if len(model.rhs) == 0:
203	            rhs_algebraic = model.concatenated_algebraic
204	        elif len(model.algebraic) == 0:
205	            rhs_algebraic = model.concatenated_rhs
206	        else:
207	            rhs_algebraic = pybamm.NumpyConcatenation(
208	                model.concatenated_rhs, model.concatenated_algebraic
209	            )
210	
211	        (
212	            rhs_algebraic,
213	            jac_rhs_algebraic,
214	            jacp_rhs_algebraic,
215	            jac_rhs_algebraic_action,
216	        ) = process(rhs_algebraic, "rhs_algebraic", vars_for_processing)
217	
218	        (
219	            casadi_switch_events,
220	            terminate_events,
221	            interpolant_extrapolation_events,
222	            discontinuity_events,
223	        ) = self._set_up_events(model, t_eval, inputs, vars_for_processing)
224	
225	        # Add the solver attributes
226	        model.rhs_eval = rhs
227	        model.algebraic_eval = algebraic
228	        model.rhs_algebraic_eval = rhs_algebraic
229	
230	        model.terminate_events_eval = terminate_events
231	        model.discontinuity_events_eval = discontinuity_events
232	        model.interpolant_extrapolation_events_eval = interpolant_extrapolation_events
233	
234	        model.jac_rhs_eval = jac_rhs
235	        model.jac_rhs_action_eval = jac_rhs_action
236	        model.jacp_rhs_eval = jacp_rhs
237	
238	        model.jac_algebraic_eval = jac_algebraic
239	        model.jac_algebraic_action_eval = jac_algebraic_action
240	        model.jacp_algebraic_eval = jacp_algebraic
241	
242	        model.jac_rhs_algebraic_eval = jac_rhs_algebraic
243	        model.jac_rhs_algebraic_action_eval = jac_rhs_algebraic_action
244	        model.jacp_rhs_algebraic_eval = jacp_rhs_algebraic
245	
246	        # Save CasADi functions for the CasADi solver
247	        # Save CasADi functions for solvers that use CasADi
248	        # Note: when we pass to casadi the ode part of the problem must be in
249	        if isinstance(self.root_method, pybamm.CasadiAlgebraicSolver) or isinstance(
250	            self, pybamm.CasadiSolver | pybamm.CasadiAlgebraicSolver
251	        ):
252	            # can use DAE solver to solve model with algebraic equations only
253	            if len(model.rhs) > 0:
254	                t_casadi = vars_for_processing["t_casadi"]
255	                y_casadi = vars_for_processing["y_casadi"]
256	                p_casadi_stacked = vars_for_processing["p_casadi_stacked"]
257	                mass_matrix_inv = casadi.MX(model.mass_matrix_inv.entries)

263	                )

265	            model.casadi_algebraic = algebraic
266	            model.casadi_sensitivities = jacp_rhs_algebraic
267	            model.casadi_sensitivities_rhs = jacp_rhs
268	            model.casadi_sensitivities_algebraic = jacp_algebraic
269

271	            self.root_method.set_up_root_solver(model, inputs, t_eval)

274	        # expressions for evaluation within the respective solver
275	        self.computed_var_fcns = {}
276	        self.computed_dvar_dy_fcns = {}
277	        self.computed_dvar_dp_fcns = {}
278	        self._time_integral_vars = {}
279	        for key in self.output_variables:
280	            # Check for any ExplicitTimeIntegral or DiscreteTimeSum variables
281	            processed_time_integral = (
282	                pybamm.ProcessedVariableTimeIntegral.from_pybamm_var(

284	                    model.len_rhs_and_alg,
285	                )
286	            )
287	            # We will evaluate the sum node in the solver and sum it afterwards
288	            if processed_time_integral is None:

292	                self._time_integral_vars[key] = processed_time_integral
293	
294	            # Generate Casadi function to calculate variable and derivates
295	            # to enable sensitivites to be computed within the solver
296	            (
297	                self.computed_var_fcns[key],
298	                self.computed_dvar_dy_fcns[key],
299	                self.computed_dvar_dp_fcns[key],
300	                _,
301	            ) = process(
302	                var,
303	                BaseSolver._wrangle_name(key),
304	                vars_for_processing,
305	                use_jacobian=True,
306	                return_jacp_stacked=True,
307	            )
308	
309	        pybamm.logger.info("Finish solver set-up")

311	    def _set_initial_conditions(self, model, time, inputs):
312	        # model should have been discretised or an error raised in Self._check_and_prepare_model_inplace
313	        len_tot = model.len_rhs_and_alg
314	        y_zero = np.zeros((len_tot, 1))
315	
316	        casadi_format = model.convert_to_format == "casadi"
317	        if casadi_format:
318	            # stack inputs
319	            inputs_y0_ics = casadi.vertcat(*[x for x in inputs.values()])
320	        else:
321	            inputs_y0_ics = inputs
322	
323	        model.y0 = model.initial_conditions_eval(time, y_zero, inputs_y0_ics)
324	
325	        if model.jacp_initial_conditions_eval is None:
326	            model.y0S = None
327	            return
328	
329	        if casadi_format:
330	            inputs_jacp_ics = inputs_y0_ics
331	        else:
332	            # we are calculating the derivative wrt the inputs
333	            # so need to make sure we convert int -> float
334	            # This is to satisfy JAX jacfwd function which requires
335	            # float inputs
336	            inputs_jacp_ics = {
337	                key: float(value) if isinstance(value, int) else value
338	                for key, value in inputs.items()
339	            }
340	
341	        model.y0S = model.jacp_initial_conditions_eval(time, y_zero, inputs_jacp_ics)

343	    @classmethod
344	    def _wrangle_name(cls, name: str) -> str:
345	        """
346	        Wrangle a function name to replace special characters
347	        """
348	        replacements = [
349	            (" ", "_"),
350	            ("[", ""),
351	            ("]", ""),
352	            (".", "_"),
353	            ("-", "_"),
354	            ("(", ""),
355	            (")", ""),
356	            ("%", "prc"),
357	            (",", ""),
358	            (".", ""),
359	        ]
360	        name = "v_" + name.casefold()
361	        for string, replacement in replacements:
362	            name = name.replace(string, replacement)
363	        return name

365	    def _check_and_prepare_model_inplace(self, model, inputs, ics_only):
366	        """
367	        Performs checks on the model and prepares it for solving.
368	        """
369	        # Check model.algebraic for ode solvers
370	        if self.ode_solver is True and len(model.algebraic) > 0:
371	            raise pybamm.SolverError(
372	                f"Cannot use ODE solver '{self.name}' to solve DAE model"
373	            )
374	        # Check model.rhs for algebraic solvers
375	        if self._algebraic_solver is True and len(model.rhs) > 0:
376	            raise pybamm.SolverError(
377	                """Cannot use algebraic solver to solve model with time derivatives"""
378	            )
379	        # casadi solver won't allow solving algebraic model so we have to raise an
380	        # error here
381	        if isinstance(self, pybamm.CasadiSolver) and len(model.rhs) == 0:
382	            raise pybamm.SolverError(
383	                "Cannot use CasadiSolver to solve algebraic model, "
384	                "use CasadiAlgebraicSolver instead"
385	            )
386	        # Discretise model if it isn't already discretised
387	        # This only works with purely 0D models, as otherwise the mesh and spatial
388	        # method should be specified by the user
389	        if model.is_discretised is False:
390	            try:
391	                disc = pybamm.Discretisation()
392	                disc.process_model(model)
393	            except pybamm.DiscretisationError as e:
394	                raise pybamm.DiscretisationError(
395	                    "Cannot automatically discretise model, "
396	                    f"model should be discretised before solving ({e})"
397	                ) from e
398	
399	        if (
400	            isinstance(self, pybamm.CasadiSolver | pybamm.CasadiAlgebraicSolver)
401	        ) and model.convert_to_format != "casadi":
402	            pybamm.logger.warning(
403	                f"Converting {model.name} to CasADi for solving with CasADi solver"
404	            )
405	            model.convert_to_format = "casadi"
406	        if (
407	            isinstance(self.root_method, pybamm.CasadiAlgebraicSolver)
408	            and model.convert_to_format != "casadi"
409	        ):
410	            pybamm.logger.warning(
411	                f"Converting {model.name} to CasADi for calculating ICs with CasADi"
412	            )
413	            model.convert_to_format = "casadi"

415	    @staticmethod
416	    def _get_vars_for_processing(model, inputs):
417	        vars_for_processing = {
418	            "model": model,
419	        }
420	
421	        if model.convert_to_format != "casadi":
422	            # Create Jacobian from concatenated rhs and algebraic
423	            y = pybamm.StateVector(slice(0, model.len_rhs_and_alg))
424	            # set up Jacobian object, for re-use of dict
425	            jacobian = pybamm.Jacobian()
426	            vars_for_processing.update({"y": y, "jacobian": jacobian})
427	            return vars_for_processing
428	
429	        else:
430	            # Convert model attributes to casadi
431	            t_casadi = casadi.MX.sym("t")
432	            # Create the symbolic state vectors
433	            y_diff = casadi.MX.sym("y_diff", model.len_rhs)
434	            y_alg = casadi.MX.sym("y_alg", model.len_alg)
435	            y_casadi = casadi.vertcat(y_diff, y_alg)
436	            p_casadi = {}
437	            for name, value in inputs.items():
438	                if isinstance(value, numbers.Number):
439	                    p_casadi[name] = casadi.MX.sym(name)
440	                else:
441	                    p_casadi[name] = casadi.MX.sym(name, value.shape[0])
442	            p_casadi_stacked = casadi.vertcat(*[p for p in p_casadi.values()])
443	            vars_for_processing.update(
444	                {
445	                    "t_casadi": t_casadi,
446	                    "y_diff": y_diff,
447	                    "y_alg": y_alg,
448	                    "y_casadi": y_casadi,
449	                    "p_casadi": p_casadi,
450	                    "p_casadi_stacked": p_casadi_stacked,
451	                }
452	            )
453	
454	            return vars_for_processing

456	    @staticmethod
457	    def _set_up_model_sensitivities_inplace(model, inputs):
458	        """
459	        Set up model attributes related to sensitivities.
460	        """
461	        has_mass_matrix = model.mass_matrix is not None
462	        has_mass_matrix_inv = model.mass_matrix_inv is not None
463	
464	        if not has_mass_matrix:
465	            return
466	
467	        model.mass_matrix = pybamm.Matrix(
468	            model.mass_matrix.entries[: model.len_rhs_and_alg, : model.len_rhs_and_alg]
469	        )
470	        if has_mass_matrix_inv:
471	            model.mass_matrix_inv = pybamm.Matrix(
472	                model.mass_matrix_inv.entries[: model.len_rhs, : model.len_rhs]
473	            )

475	    def _set_up_events(self, model, t_eval, inputs, vars_for_processing):
476	        # Check for heaviside and modulo functions in rhs and algebraic and add
477	        # discontinuity events if these exist.
478	        # Note: only checks for the case of t < X, t <= X, X < t, or X <= t,
479	        # but also accounts for the fact that t might be dimensional
480	        # Only do this for DAE models as ODE models can deal with discontinuities
481	        # fine
482	
483	        if len(model.algebraic) > 0:
484	            for symbol in itertools.chain(
485	                model.concatenated_rhs.pre_order(),
486	                model.concatenated_algebraic.pre_order(),
487	            ):
488	                if isinstance(symbol, _Heaviside):
489	                    if symbol.right == pybamm.t:
490	                        expr = symbol.left
491	                    elif symbol.left == pybamm.t:
492	                        expr = symbol.right
493	                    else:
494	                        # Heaviside function does not contain pybamm.t as an argument.
495	                        # Do not create an event
496	                        continue  # pragma: no cover
497	
498	                    model.events.append(
499	                        pybamm.Event(
500	                            str(symbol),
501	                            expr,
502	                            pybamm.EventType.DISCONTINUITY,
503	                        )
504	                    )
505	
506	                elif isinstance(symbol, pybamm.Modulo) and symbol.left == pybamm.t:
507	                    expr = symbol.right
508	                    num_events = 200 if (t_eval is None) else (t_eval[-1] // expr.value)
509	
510	                    for i in np.arange(num_events):
511	                        model.events.append(
512	                            pybamm.Event(
513	                                str(symbol),
514	                                expr * pybamm.Scalar(i + 1),
515	                                pybamm.EventType.DISCONTINUITY,
516	                            )
517	                        )
518	                else:
519	                    continue
520	
521	        casadi_switch_events = []
522	        terminate_events = []
523	        interpolant_extrapolation_events = []
524	        discontinuity_events = []
525	        for n, event in enumerate(model.events):
526	            if event.event_type == pybamm.EventType.DISCONTINUITY:
527	                # discontinuity events are evaluated before the solver is called,
528	                # so don't need to process them
529	                discontinuity_events.append(event)
530	            elif event.event_type == pybamm.EventType.SWITCH and (
531	                isinstance(self, pybamm.CasadiSolver)
532	                and self.mode == "fast with events"
533	                and model.algebraic != {}
534	            ):
535	                # Save some events to casadi_switch_events for the 'fast with
536	                # events' mode of the casadi solver
537	                # We only need to do this if the model is a DAE model
538	                # see #1082
539	                k = 20
540	                # address numpy 1.25 deprecation warning: array should have
541	                # ndim=0 before conversion
542	                init_sign = float(
543	                    np.sign(event.evaluate(0, model.y0.full(), inputs=inputs)).item()
544	                )
545	                # We create a sigmoid for each event which will multiply the
546	                # rhs. Doing * 2 - 1 ensures that when the event is crossed,
547	                # the sigmoid is zero. Hence the rhs is zero and the solution
548	                # stays constant for the rest of the simulation period
549	                # We can then cut off the part after the event was crossed
550	                event_sigmoid = (
551	                    pybamm.sigmoid(0, init_sign * event.expression, k) * 2 - 1
552	                )
553	                event_casadi = process(
554	                    event_sigmoid,
555	                    f"event_{n}",
556	                    vars_for_processing,
557	                    use_jacobian=False,
558	                )[0]
559	                # use the actual casadi object as this will go into the rhs
560	                casadi_switch_events.append(event_casadi)
561	            else:
562	                # use the function call
563	                event_call = process(
564	                    event.expression,
565	                    f"event_{n}",
566	                    vars_for_processing,
567	                    use_jacobian=False,
568	                )[0]
569	                if event.event_type == pybamm.EventType.TERMINATION:
570	                    terminate_events.append(event_call)
571	                elif event.event_type == pybamm.EventType.INTERPOLANT_EXTRAPOLATION:
572	                    interpolant_extrapolation_events.append(event_call)
573	
574	        return (
575	            casadi_switch_events,
576	            terminate_events,
577	            interpolant_extrapolation_events,
578	            discontinuity_events,
579	        )

581	    def _set_consistent_initialization(self, model, time, inputs_dict):
582	        """
583	        Set initialized states for the model. This is skipped if the solver is an
584	        algebraic solver (since this would make the algebraic solver redundant), and if
585	        the model doesn't have any algebraic equations (since there are no initial
586	        conditions to be calculated in this case).
587	
588	        Parameters
589	        ----------
590	        model : :class:`pybamm.BaseModel`
591	            The model for which to calculate initial conditions.
592	        time : numeric type
593	            The time at which to calculate the initial conditions
594	        inputs_dict : dict
595	            Any input parameters to pass to the model when solving
596	        update_rhs : bool
597	            Whether to update the rhs. True for 'solve', False for 'step'.
598	
599	        """
600	
601	        if self._algebraic_solver or model.len_alg == 0:
602	            # Don't update model.y0
603	            return
604	
605	        # Calculate consistent states for the algebraic equations
606	        model.y0 = self.calculate_consistent_state(model, time, inputs_dict)
607	
608	    def calculate_consistent_state(self, model, time=0, inputs=None):
609	        """
610	        Calculate consistent state for the algebraic equations through
611	        root-finding. model.y0 is used as the initial guess for rootfinding
612	
613	        Parameters
614	        ----------
615	        model : :class:`pybamm.BaseModel`
616	            The model for which to calculate initial conditions.
617	        time : float
618	            The time at which to calculate the initial conditions
619	        inputs: dict, optional
620	            Any input parameters to pass to the model when solving
621	
622	        Returns
623	        -------
624	        y0_consistent : array-like, same shape as y0_guess
625	            Initial conditions that are consistent with the algebraic equations (roots
626	            of the algebraic equations). If self.root_method == None then returns
627	            model.y0.
628	        """
629	        pybamm.logger.debug("Start calculating consistent states")
630	        if self.root_method is None:
631	            return model.y0
632	        try:
633	            root_sol = self.root_method._integrate(model, np.array([time]), inputs)
634	        except pybamm.SolverError as e:
635	            raise pybamm.SolverError(
636	                f"Could not find consistent states: {e.args[0]}"
637	            ) from e
638	        pybamm.logger.debug("Found consistent states")
639	
640	        self.check_extrapolation(root_sol, model.events)
641	        y0 = root_sol.all_ys[0]
642	        return y0

644	    def _solve_process_calculate_sensitivities_arg(
645	        inputs, model, calculate_sensitivities
646	    ):
647	        # get a list-only version of calculate_sensitivities
648	        if isinstance(calculate_sensitivities, bool):
649	            if calculate_sensitivities:
650	                calculate_sensitivities_list = [p for p in inputs.keys()]
651	            else:
652	                calculate_sensitivities_list = []
653	        else:
654	            calculate_sensitivities_list = calculate_sensitivities
655	
656	        calculate_sensitivities_list.sort()
657	        if not hasattr(model, "calculate_sensitivities"):
658	            model.calculate_sensitivities = []
659	
660	        # Check that calculate_sensitivites have not been updated
661	        sensitivities_have_changed = (
662	            calculate_sensitivities_list != model.calculate_sensitivities
663	        )
664	
665	        # save sensitivity parameters so we can identify them later on
666	        # (FYI: this is used in the Solution class)
667	        model.calculate_sensitivities = calculate_sensitivities_list
668	
669	        return calculate_sensitivities_list, sensitivities_have_changed

671	    def solve(
672	        self,
673	        model,
674	        t_eval=None,
675	        inputs=None,
676	        nproc=None,
677	        calculate_sensitivities=False,
678	        t_interp=None,
679	    ):
680	        """
681	        Execute the solver setup and calculate the solution of the model at
682	        specified times.
683	
684	        Parameters
685	        ----------
686	        model : :class:`pybamm.BaseModel`
687	            The model whose solution to calculate. Must have attributes rhs and
688	            initial_conditions. All calls to solve must pass in the same model or
689	            an error is raised
690	        t_eval : None, list or ndarray, optional
691	            The times (in seconds) at which to compute the solution. Defaults to None.
692	        inputs : dict or list, optional
693	            A dictionary or list of dictionaries describing any input parameters to
694	            pass to the model when solving
695	        nproc : int, optional
696	            Number of processes to use when solving for more than one set of input
697	            parameters. Defaults to value returned by "os.cpu_count()".
698	        calculate_sensitivities : list of str or bool, optional
699	            Whether the solver calculates sensitivities of all input parameters. Defaults to False.
700	            If only a subset of sensitivities are required, can also pass a
701	            list of input parameter names.  **Limitations**: sensitivities are not calculated up to numerical tolerances
702	            so are not guarenteed to be within the tolerances set by the solver, please raise an issue if you
703	            require this functionality. Also, when using this feature with `pybamm.Experiment`, the sensitivities
704	            do not take into account the movement of step-transitions wrt input parameters, so do not use this feature
705	            if the timings of your experimental protocol change rapidly with respect to your input parameters.
706	        t_interp : None, list or ndarray, optional
707	            The times (in seconds) at which to interpolate the solution. Defaults to None.
708	            Only valid for solvers that support intra-solve interpolation (`IDAKLUSolver`).
709	
710	        Returns
711	        -------
712	        :class:`pybamm.Solution` or list of :class:`pybamm.Solution` objects.
713	             If type of `inputs` is `list`, return a list of corresponding
714	             :class:`pybamm.Solution` objects.
715	
716	        Raises
717	        ------
718	        :class:`pybamm.ModelError`
719	            If an empty model is passed (`model.rhs = {}` and `model.algebraic={}` and
720	            `model.variables = {}`)
721	        :class:`RuntimeError`
722	            If multiple calls to `solve` pass in different models
723	
724	        """
725	        pybamm.logger.info(f"Start solving {model.name} with {self.name}")
726	
727	        # Make sure model isn't empty
728	        self._check_empty_model(model)
729	
730	        # t_eval can only be None if the solver is an algebraic solver. In that case
731	        # set it to 0
732	        if t_eval is None:
733	            if self._algebraic_solver is False:
734	                raise ValueError("t_eval cannot be None")
735	            t_eval = np.array([0])
736	
737	        # If t_eval is provided as [t0, tf] return the solution at 100 points
738	        elif isinstance(t_eval, list):
739	            if len(t_eval) == 1 and self._algebraic_solver is True:
740	                t_eval = np.array(t_eval)
741	            elif len(t_eval) != 2:
742	                raise pybamm.SolverError(
743	                    "'t_eval' can be provided as an array of times at which to "
744	                    "return the solution, or as a list [t0, tf] where t0 is the "
745	                    "initial time and tf is the final time, but has been provided "
746	                    f"as a list of length {len(t_eval)}."
747	                )
748	            elif not self.supports_interp:
749	                t_eval = np.linspace(t_eval[0], t_eval[-1], 100)
750	
751	        # Make sure t_eval is monotonic
752	        if (np.diff(t_eval) < 0).any():
753	            raise pybamm.SolverError("t_eval must increase monotonically")
754	
755	        t_interp = self.process_t_interp(t_interp)
756	
757	        # Set up inputs
758	        #
759	        # Argument "inputs" can be either a list of input dicts or
760	        # a single dict. The remaining of this function is only working
761	        # with variable "input_list", which is a list of dictionaries.
762	        # If "inputs" is a single dict, "inputs_list" is a list of only one dict.
763	        inputs_list = inputs if isinstance(inputs, list) else [inputs]
764	        model_inputs_list = [
765	            self._set_up_model_inputs(model, inputs) for inputs in inputs_list
766	        ]
767	
768	        calculate_sensitivities_list, sensitivities_have_changed = (
769	            BaseSolver._solve_process_calculate_sensitivities_arg(
770	                model_inputs_list[0], model, calculate_sensitivities
771	            )
772	        )
773	
774	        # (Re-)calculate consistent initialization
775	        # Assuming initial conditions do not depend on input parameters
776	        # when len(inputs_list) > 1, only `model_inputs_list[0]`
777	        # is passed to `_set_consistent_initialization`.
778	        # See https://github.com/pybamm-team/PyBaMM/pull/1261
779	        if len(model_inputs_list) > 1:
780	            all_inputs_names = set(
781	                itertools.chain.from_iterable(
782	                    [model_inputs.keys() for model_inputs in model_inputs_list]
783	                )
784	            )
785	            if all_inputs_names:
786	                initial_conditions_node_names = set(
787	                    [
788	                        it.name
789	                        for it in model.concatenated_initial_conditions.pre_order()
790	                    ]
791	                )
792	                if all_inputs_names.issubset(initial_conditions_node_names):
793	                    raise pybamm.SolverError(
794	                        "Input parameters cannot appear in expression "
795	                        "for initial conditions."
796	                    )
797	
798	        # if any setup configuration has changed, we need to re-set up
799	        if sensitivities_have_changed:
800	            self._model_set_up.pop(model, None)
801	            # CasadiSolver caches its integrators using model, so delete this too
802	            if isinstance(self, pybamm.CasadiSolver):
803	                self.integrators.pop(model, None)
804	
805	        # save sensitivity parameters so we can identify them later on
806	        # (FYI: this is used in the Solution class)
807	        model.calculate_sensitivities = calculate_sensitivities_list
808	
809	        # Set up (if not done already)
810	        timer = pybamm.Timer()
811	        # Set the initial conditions
812	        if model not in self._model_set_up:
813	            if len(self._model_set_up) > 0:
814	                existing_model = next(iter(self._model_set_up))
815	                raise RuntimeError(
816	                    "This solver has already been initialised for model "
817	                    f'"{existing_model.name}". Please create a separate '
818	                    "solver for this model"
819	                )
820	            # It is assumed that when len(inputs_list) > 1, model set
821	            # up (initial condition, time-scale and length-scale) does
822	            # not depend on input parameters. Therefore, only `model_inputs[0]`
823	            # is passed to `set_up`.
824	            # See https://github.com/pybamm-team/PyBaMM/pull/1261
825	            self.set_up(model, model_inputs_list[0], t_eval)
826	            self._model_set_up.update(
827	                {model: {"initial conditions": model.concatenated_initial_conditions}}
828	            )
829	        elif (
830	            self._model_set_up[model]["initial conditions"]
831	            != model.concatenated_initial_conditions
832	        ):
833	            if self._algebraic_solver:
834	                # For an algebraic solver, we don't need to set up the initial
835	                # conditions function and we can just evaluate
836	                # model.concatenated_initial_conditions
837	                model.y0 = model.concatenated_initial_conditions.evaluate()
838	            else:
839	                # If the new initial conditions are different
840	                # and cannot be evaluated directly, set up again
841	                self.set_up(model, model_inputs_list[0], t_eval, ics_only=True)
842	            self._model_set_up[model]["initial conditions"] = (
843	                model.concatenated_initial_conditions
844	            )
845	        else:
846	            # Set the standard initial conditions
847	            self._set_initial_conditions(model, t_eval[0], model_inputs_list[0])
848	
849	        # Solve for the consistent initialization
850	        self._set_consistent_initialization(model, t_eval[0], model_inputs_list[0])
851	
852	        set_up_time = timer.time()
853	        timer.reset()
854	
855	        # Check initial conditions don't violate events
856	        self._check_events_with_initialization(t_eval, model, model_inputs_list[0])
857	
858	        # Process discontinuities
859	        (
860	            start_indices,
861	            end_indices,
862	            t_eval,
863	        ) = self._get_discontinuity_start_end_indices(model, inputs, t_eval)
864	
865	        # Integrate separately over each time segment and accumulate into the solution
866	        # object, restarting the solver at each discontinuity (and recalculating a
867	        # consistent state afterwards if a DAE)
868	        old_y0 = model.y0
869	        solutions = None
870	        for start_index, end_index in zip(start_indices, end_indices, strict=False):
871	            pybamm.logger.verbose(
872	                f"Calling solver for {t_eval[start_index]} < t < {t_eval[end_index - 1]}"
873	            )
874	            if self.supports_parallel_solve:
875	                # Jax and IDAKLU solver can accept a list of inputs
876	                new_solutions = self._integrate(
877	                    model,
878	                    t_eval[start_index:end_index],
879	                    model_inputs_list,
880	                    t_interp,
881	                )
882	            else:
883	                ninputs = len(model_inputs_list)
884	                if ninputs == 1:
885	                    new_solution = self._integrate(
886	                        model,
887	                        t_eval[start_index:end_index],
888	                        model_inputs_list[0],
889	                        t_interp=t_interp,
890	                    )
891	                    new_solutions = [new_solution]
892	                else:
893	                    with mp.get_context(self._mp_context).Pool(processes=nproc) as p:
894	                        new_solutions = p.starmap(
895	                            self._integrate,
896	                            zip(
897	                                [model] * ninputs,
898	                                [t_eval[start_index:end_index]] * ninputs,
899	                                model_inputs_list,
900	                                [t_interp] * ninputs,
901	                                strict=False,
902	                            ),
903	                        )
904	                        p.close()
905	                        p.join()
906	            # Setting the solve time for each segment.
907	            # pybamm.Solution.__add__ assumes attribute solve_time.
908	            solve_time = timer.time()
909	            for sol in new_solutions:
910	                sol.solve_time = solve_time
911	            if start_index == start_indices[0]:
912	                solutions = [sol for sol in new_solutions]
913	            else:
914	                for i, new_solution in enumerate(new_solutions):
915	                    solutions[i] = solutions[i] + new_solution
916	
917	            if solutions[0].termination != "final time":
918	                break
919	
920	            if end_index != len(t_eval):
921	                # setup for next integration subsection
922	                last_state = solutions[0].y[:, -1]
923	                # update y0 (for DAE solvers, this updates the initial guess for the
924	                # rootfinder)
925	                model.y0 = last_state
926	                if len(model.algebraic) > 0:
927	                    model.y0 = self.calculate_consistent_state(
928	                        model, t_eval[end_index], model_inputs_list[0]
929	                    )
930	        solve_time = timer.time()
931	
932	        for i, solution in enumerate(solutions):
933	            # Check if extrapolation occurred
934	            self.check_extrapolation(solution, model.events)
935	            # Identify the event that caused termination and update the solution to
936	            # include the event time and state
937	            solutions[i], termination = self.get_termination_reason(
938	                solution, model.events
939	            )
940	            # Assign times
941	            solutions[i].set_up_time = set_up_time
942	            # all solutions get the same solve time, but their integration time
943	            # will be different (see https://github.com/pybamm-team/PyBaMM/pull/1261)
944	            solutions[i].solve_time = solve_time
945	
946	        # Restore old y0
947	        model.y0 = old_y0
948	
949	        # Report times
950	        if len(solutions) == 1:
951	            pybamm.logger.info(f"Finish solving {model.name} ({termination})")
952	            pybamm.logger.info(
953	                f"Set-up time: {solutions[0].set_up_time}, Solve time: {solutions[0].solve_time} (of which integration time: {solutions[0].integration_time}), "
954	                f"Total time: {solutions[0].total_time}"
955	            )
956	        else:
957	            pybamm.logger.info(f"Finish solving {model.name} for all inputs")
958	            pybamm.logger.info(
959	                f"Set-up time: {solutions[0].set_up_time}, Solve time: {solutions[0].solve_time}, Total time: {solutions[0].total_time}"
960	            )
961	
962	        # Raise error if solutions[0] only contains one timestep (except for algebraic
963	        # solvers, where we may only expect one time in the solution)
964	        if (
965	            self._algebraic_solver is False
966	            and len(solutions[0].all_ts) == 1
967	            and len(solutions[0].all_ts[0]) == 1
968	        ):
969	            raise pybamm.SolverError(
970	                "Solution time vector has length 1. "
971	                "Check whether simulation terminated too early."
972	            )
973	
974	        # Return solution(s)
975	        if len(solutions) == 1:
976	            return solutions[0]
977	        else:
978	            return solutions

980	    @staticmethod
981	    def _get_discontinuity_start_end_indices(model, inputs, t_eval):
982	        if not model.discontinuity_events_eval:
983	            pybamm.logger.verbose("No discontinuity events found")
984	            return [0], [len(t_eval)], t_eval
985	
986	        # Calculate discontinuities
987	        discontinuities = [
988	            # Assuming that discontinuities do not depend on
989	            # input parameters when len(input_list) > 1, only
990	            # `inputs` is passed to `evaluate`.
991	            # See https://github.com/pybamm-team/PyBaMM/pull/1261
992	            event.expression.evaluate(inputs=inputs)
993	            for event in model.discontinuity_events_eval
994	        ]
995	
996	        # make sure they are increasing in time
997	        discontinuities = sorted(discontinuities)
998	
999	        # remove any identical discontinuities
1000	        discontinuities = [
1001	            v
1002	            for i, v in enumerate(discontinuities)
1003	            if (
1004	                i == len(discontinuities) - 1
1005	                or discontinuities[i] < discontinuities[i + 1]
1006	            )
1007	            and v > 0
1008	        ]
1009	
1010	        # remove any discontinuities after end of t_eval
1011	        discontinuities = [v for v in discontinuities if v < t_eval[-1]]
1012	
1013	        pybamm.logger.verbose(f"Discontinuity events found at t = {discontinuities}")
1014	        if isinstance(inputs, list):
1015	            raise pybamm.SolverError(
1016	                "Cannot solve for a list of input parameters sets with discontinuities"
1017	            )
1018	
1019	        # insert time points around discontinuities in t_eval
1020	        # keep track of subsections to integrate by storing start and end indices
1021	        start_indices = [0]
1022	        end_indices = []
1023	        eps = sys.float_info.epsilon
1024	        for dtime in discontinuities:
1025	            dindex = np.searchsorted(t_eval, dtime, side="left")
1026	            end_indices.append(dindex + 1)
1027	            start_indices.append(dindex + 1)
1028	            if dtime * (1 - eps) < t_eval[dindex] < dtime * (1 + eps):
1029	                t_eval[dindex] *= 1 + eps
1030	                t_eval = np.insert(t_eval, dindex, dtime * (1 - eps))
1031	            else:
1032	                t_eval = np.insert(
1033	                    t_eval, dindex, [dtime * (1 - eps), dtime * (1 + eps)]
1034	                )
1035	        end_indices.append(len(t_eval))
1036	
1037	        return start_indices, end_indices, t_eval
